data.one_liner: Provides immutable tuple classes for grouping values.
data.what_it_does: The package defines Tuple1 through Tuple7 classes that hold a fixed number of items. Instances are immutable, hashable, and can be used as map keys.
use_when: Need to group a small fixed number of heterogeneous values
Legacy code depends on Tuple classes
Require stable hash codes for tuples in collections
avoid_when: Prefer Dart 3.0 records for new code
Performance-critical code where a lightweight struct is needed
weaknesses: Feature complete but not actively enhanced
Superseded by Dart records in newer versions
